Title: LCExpiryReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Days before LC expiry on which a reminder is sent. Edit this list to change when alerts fire - no flow redeployment needed.

Title: ShipmentDeadlineReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Days before the latest shipment date on which a reminder is sent.

Title: PresentationDeadlineReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Days before the presentation deadline on which a reminder is sent.

Title: ProceedsMaturityReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Days before proceeds maturity on which a reminder is sent.

Title: TaskDueReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Days before a task due date on which the assignee is reminded. 0 means on the due date.

Title: MissingDocumentReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Reminder cadence in days while required documents remain missing on an active LC.

Title: AmendmentActionReminderDays
ConfigDescription: Reminder cadence in days while an amendment sits in Pending Acceptance.

Title: DiscrepancyEscalationDays
ConfigDescription: Days a discrepancy may stay open before escalating to level 1. Overridden per category by 24_DiscrepancyCategories.EscalateAfterDays.

Title: DiscrepancyEscalationLevel2Days
ConfigDescription: Days open before escalating to the treasury manager.

Title: OverdueTaskEscalationDays
ConfigDescription: Days a task may stay overdue before the assignee's manager is copied.

Title: ProceedsOverdueEscalationDays
ConfigDescription: Days past maturity before outstanding proceeds are escalated.

Title: EscalationManagerEmail
ConfigDescription: Fallback escalation recipient when a user has no ManagerEmail in 17_Users. Set this before go-live.

Title: AmendmentApprovalThreshold
ConfigDescription: Amendment amount increase, in USD equivalent, above which treasury manager approval is required.

Title: LCClosureRequiresApproval
ConfigDescription: Whether closing or cancelling an LC requires treasury manager approval.

Title: DiscrepancyWriteOffThreshold
ConfigDescription: USD equivalent above which writing off outstanding proceeds requires manager approval.

Title: ApprovalReminderHours
ConfigDescription: Hours before an unanswered approval request is re-sent.

Title: DefaultPresentationPeriodDays
ConfigDescription: Presentation period applied when the LC does not state one. UCP 600 art. 14c default.

Title: DefaultBankExaminationDays
ConfigDescription: Banking days allowed for document examination. UCP 600 art. 14b.

Title: AllowShipmentDateAfterExpiry
ConfigDescription: When FALSE the app blocks saving an LC whose latest shipment date is after its expiry date.

Title: AllowNegativeOutstanding
ConfigDescription: When FALSE the app warns when invoices drawn exceed the LC maximum amount.

Title: DuplicateLCNumberCheck
ConfigDescription: Check for an existing LC with the same LC number before saving a new registration.

Title: DuplicateInvoiceScope
ConfigDescription: PerLC checks invoice number uniqueness within one LC; Global checks across the whole register.

Title: RequireGoodsDescription
ConfigDescription: Whether goods description is mandatory before an LC can leave Draft.

Title: LCIDPattern
ConfigDescription: Internal LC ID pattern. {YYYY} is the received year, {####} a zero-padded sequence within that year.

Title: AmendmentIDPattern
ConfigDescription: Amendment reference pattern.

Title: PresentationIDPattern
ConfigDescription: Presentation reference pattern.

Title: ProceedsIDPattern
ConfigDescription: Proceeds reference pattern.

Title: DiscrepancyIDPattern
ConfigDescription: Discrepancy reference pattern.

Title: DashboardExpiringSoonDays
ConfigDescription: Window in days for the Expiring Soon KPI card.

Title: DashboardShipmentSoonDays
ConfigDescription: Window in days for the Shipment Deadline Approaching KPI card.

Title: DashboardNewLCDays
ConfigDescription: Window in days for the New LCs KPI card.

Title: DashboardMaturitySoonDays
ConfigDescription: Window in days for the Proceeds Maturing KPI card.

Title: DashboardRegisterPageSize
ConfigDescription: Rows fetched per page in the LC register. Keep at or below 100 to stay inside the delegation limit.

Title: DashboardRefreshMinutes
ConfigDescription: Minutes before cached dashboard counts are considered stale and refetched.

Title: CriticalAuditFields
ConfigDescription: Fields whose changes are flagged IsCriticalField in 10_AuditLog and surfaced in the Audit tab's default filter.

Title: AuditRetentionMonths
ConfigDescription: Months of audit history to retain online. Older partitions are archived by the admin archive job - see docs/07-deployment-runbook.md.

Title: AuditLogFullRecordOnCreate
ConfigDescription: Whether a create action writes one audit row per populated field or a single summary row.

Title: ImportMaxRowsPerBatch
ConfigDescription: Maximum source rows accepted in a single import batch.

Title: ImportDuplicateAction
ConfigDescription: Default action when an imported LC number already exists: Skip, Update Existing or Create New.

Title: ImportRequireAdminCommit
ConfigDescription: When TRUE, staged rows can only be committed by a user with the ADMIN role.

Title: ImportAutoCreateCustomers
ConfigDescription: When FALSE the importer rejects rows whose customer is not already in 11_Customers, which stops the master data drifting.

Title: NotificationFromDisplayName
ConfigDescription: Display name used on notification emails.

Title: NotificationSuppressWeekends
ConfigDescription: When TRUE, scheduled reminder flows do not send on Saturday or Sunday and roll forward to Monday.

Title: NotificationDigestEnabled
ConfigDescription: Whether a single daily digest replaces individual reminder emails per user.

Title: NotificationDigestHourUTC
ConfigDescription: Hour in UTC at which the daily digest is sent. 5 UTC is 08:00 in UTC+3.

Title: PortalDisplayName
ConfigDescription: Name shown in the portal header.

Title: PortalSupportEmail
ConfigDescription: Support mailbox shown in the portal footer and in notification emails. Set this before go-live.

Title: BaseReportingCurrency
ConfigDescription: Currency all exposure reports normalise to using 14_Currencies.RateToUSD.

Title: FinancialYearStartMonth
ConfigDescription: Month number the financial year starts in. Drives year-to-date report ranges.
